summary: Reviews v3: merge conflicts, reviewers, group by repository, hide and decline. Conflicts ride on PrSummary (mergeConflicts, conflictedFiles): GitHub from mergeable in the list query (it never names the files), Bitbucket from the diffstat's 'merge conflict' entries, read with the list's enrichment for open PRs you are involved in and cached against the PR's updated_on plus the target branch's commit, so a moved main re-reads it and nothing reads faster than the refresh rule. They show once in the list row (needs you, ahead of a failed build), the header line, an Overview callout naming the files, the Merge card blocker and the Files tree (status 'conflicted', no longer mapped to modified); 'Ask the agent to resolve' sends one review pill with the base, the files and 'merge the base in, never rebase or force-push'. The Reviewers card adds a reviewer from a combobox (recent reviewers of the repository first, then collaborators and teams on GitHub, workspace members on Bitbucket) and removes one from a row's hover menu (GitHub: only a pending request). The ⋯ menu hides a PR locally (backend table pull_request_hidden; it comes back when it changes after the hide and needs you, and the hide is then cleared) and declines it (Bitbucket) or closes it (GitHub) after a confirm naming it. Reviewer changes and decline are three new admin-scoped write channels with validation, a fresh re-read (open, viewerCanManage: author, or write access to the repository) and the usual error mapping. The list toggles By status / By repository, with collapsible repository sections; both are settings.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: mobile-v0.5.0, with the Reviews tab. The phone has no Reviews screen; the three new write channels (add-reviewer, remove-reviewer, decline) are admin-scoped like the other writes, so a paired phone is refused even if it called them (tests/unit/device-auth.test.ts). The new PrSummary and PrListData fields are additive and nothing on the phone reads them yet.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android 0.6.0, with the Reviews destination. No Android code calls the new channels and the backend refuses the writes for a phone credential, so nothing unfinished is reachable.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, signing, deep link, update channel or wire-protocol frame change. The new table is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on migrate and an older build ignores it. The new channels are additive request/response channels; an older backend answers them with the unknown-channel error, which the control shows as its error line, and its list has no `hidden` field, which the renderer reads as nothing hidden (a desktop and its SSH backend are re-provisioned to the same version on connect anyway). The new settings keys reviews.groupBy and reviews.collapsedRepos default to By status and nothing collapsed.

automated: npm run typecheck and npm test passed.

vitest: conflict mapping on both hosts (GitHub mergeable CONFLICTING/MERGEABLE/UNKNOWN, merged never conflicting; Bitbucket diffstat 'merge conflict' named files, files status conflicted, the diffstat re-read when the target branch commit moves and not otherwise), row status and blocker order, group by repository order, collapse and filter rule, the hide and come-back rule and its IPC wiring over the demo data, reviewer id validation, the re-read prechecks (stale, forbidden, invalid), candidate order, request shaping for add/remove reviewer (GitHub reviewers vs team_reviewers on requested_reviewers, Bitbucket GET then PUT with title and the full reviewers list) and decline/close (Bitbucket POST decline, GitHub PATCH state closed), the repository permission read once per repository from the documented /user/workspaces/{workspace}/permissions/repositories (the removed /user/permissions/repositories is never called), error mapping, and the phone refused on the three new write channels.

e2e/review-writes.e2e.mjs against the demo provider: conflicts in the row, header, callout, Merge card and Files tree; add a reviewer from the combobox and remove one from the row menu; By repository sections, fold and saved settings; hide, show and restore; no Close on a PR you may not manage; decline Cancel sends nothing, Decline removes the row. 37/37 passed. e2e/review-to-chat.e2e.mjs: the conflicts pill lands with the base and files.

SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens: reviews and reviews-files baselines rewritten, reviews-conflict and reviews-by-repo added, in all three themes; the chat, confirm-dialog and host-write-approval baselines changed only in the linked #612 chip's icon (now the conflict glyph). Sub-threshold noise baselines were restored. Two further runs without updating both passed.
hardware: Every changed baseline was read by eye on this Mac; that moved the callout's button under its text, which the first version squeezed.
Live read-only gh check against tejasnafde/switchboard: the list query with mergeable and Team reviewers parses, detail reads viewerPermission, and collaborators/teams list without error.
notExercised: No write was ever sent to a real host. Never exercised live: GitHub POST and DELETE pulls/:n/requested_reviewers, PATCH pulls/:n; Bitbucket PUT pullrequests/:id with reviewers, POST pullrequests/:id/decline.

Never exercised live on Bitbucket (no account on this machine): the diffstat conflict read in the list, GET workspaces/:ws/members, GET user/permissions/repositories with a q filter. The scope names in the Settings help text (read:workspace:bitbucket for members) follow Atlassian's docs and were not checked against a real token.
React Native and native Android are staged; nothing was run on a phone.
